active_strategy.name: trend
active_strategy.evidence: Only 4h strategy passing walk-forward OOS (2025-08-23..2026-10-13) after fees/slippage/funding: +7.0%, PF 1.86, maxDD 5.0%, 65 trades, 4/5 markets positive; see results/backtest_report.md

shadow_strategy.name: breakout
shadow_strategy.evidence: SHADOW only (not active). Most robust family in review (100% of params positive OOS) but 3.5-month OOS, bootstrap p=0.036, not significant after multiple-testing correction. Evaluate >=8 weeks / >=30 trades.

test_strategies.name: breakout1h_filtered
test_strategies.evidence: TEST portfolio (research2/candidates.py, preregistered fixed params). Not validated for activation; observed independently with its own €50.

test_strategies.name: funding_fade_trend
test_strategies.evidence: EXPERIMENTAL — best backtest so far, hold-out failed, low-moderate confidence (research4 R3).

hf_strategy.name: zscore5m
hf_strategy.evidence: EXPERIMENTAL — backtest NEGATIVE (research3 H2 zrev5m: −6.7% net, PF 0.78, halted at 10% DD; gross +€0.44). Observation-only paper test, very low confidence. Runs every 60 s in hf_runner.

session._doc: Single config for Actions sessions. duration_min 0 = unbegrenzt (pauses at job budget unless chain_jobs). Dashboard settings panel generates these values.

plugins._doc: Strategy plug-in point for research5 (other worker). A module exposing STRATEGIES={version:{name,tf,params,fn,...}} and optionally a phases module exposing phase_reports(store_dir)->list.

strategy_verdicts._doc: research5 verdicts (backtest_report.md / strategy_verdicts.md). Discarded strategies keep running hourly as-is (data kept) but are labeled VERWORFEN.
